subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed `SKILL.md` diagnostics be considered resolved by a `skills lint` validation command, or must normal skill list/check/status/Web surfaces also report skipped candidates before this issue closes?
rationale: Current main still silently omits invalid candidates, and the open PR is a plausible lint-first fix but does not obviously satisfy the issue's broader normal-output and Web-console request.

options.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
options.body: Treat `skills lint` as useful but require skipped-candidate diagnostics in the normal maintainer-approved status/list/Web path before resolving this issue.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land a corrected `skills lint` command as the first supported diagnostic surface and track normal status/Web visibility separately.

options.title: Narrow to documentation
options.body: Decide that docs plus an explicit validation command are sufficient and close the broader warning-surface request once the command lands.

recommendation.title: Require normal-surface diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat `skills lint` as useful but require skipped-candidate diagnostics in the normal maintainer-approved status/list/Web path before resolving this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` appears in the parser/docs and nested skills history and is the best available owner for a cross-surface product-scope call.
